notes.title: Crafting Chaos Update + Kickstarter
notes.notes:
The Crafting Chaos Update
Here is the Crafting Chaos Update. We have brought back crafting by overhauling it with better features, new weapons & armor to craft!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/92f8184d015675a77877af1da893102377f3df87.png

Crafting
The crafting menu has been redone. It will be improved again in the final version of the game. However crafting recipes now appear when craftable. You need to collect rock, snow, sticks and sand to make all sorts of weapons and armor!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/4b5bd7783fb3306a39ac1f049a7d02bfa2227a05.png

Chaotic Weapons!
Collect sticks and make spears. Which your Reclaimers will then poke these poor orcs with! Orc below had a series of unfortunate events...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/3de8391fba9708890a897a3ab0a89c650e0a5014.png

Also EXPLOSIONS!!!
That's it, just lots of explosions now...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/76d4079b71aec890042875cebc6c33746eceaef3.png


Energy Mechanic
New feature is your classic tech tree for your Reclaimers organs. You can now use the energy from harvesting berries to make your Reclaimers stronger, tougher and apparently giant sized?!?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/d3511979fc8dfd0c913f27dd04e4a084e64c178b.png


And finally!

Our New Kickstarter!
Launching on February 1st is our Kickstarter Fundraiser! Go follow our page to build the hype:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lnoyoutuber/help-purge-the-programmer-art-reclaimers-steam-game 

We are going to be purging all the programmer art from the game! As you know I am a solo game developer - who also cannot draw for his life - since I am your stereotypial programmer (;

Below is some of the art you can help destroy and remove from Reclaimers:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/fec6b34de7a6f343da5000c767e11b14c6ccab19.png

Cheers & thanks for the support!
Luke

notes.title: Version 0.6 Update! The Troll Level Is Impossible!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Our latest update involves all things Reclaiming! 

There is now a level system where you work your way through conquering and hopping between different islands. Reaching new levels you will come across new biomes, harder enemy's and more loot!

Level 1 - Grass Lands
The tutorial level will have you fight the orc stronghold located on the island. Your objective is to capture the flag and take control of the island. Recruit an army, crush the orcs and take the boat to the next island!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/d9a181b9b4ece77eb5e4826788b6641fcb187dcb.png

Level 2 - Forest Island
You have crashed landed on the next island, this time a slightly bigger island with forests. Similar to last time, you have to crush three orc camps to reclaim the island!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/1545fe3338496fdf35485fef332845627439e09d.png

Level 3 - Troll Territory
Reach the heights of the troll island, where mountain ranges hold dangers that are far more dangerous... 

I'm not going to lie, noone can currently get past this level... Pretty sure it's because the troll is one of the most toughest enemies in the game and your army of reclaimers have no way to get any decent loot at this point of the game (will be fixed soon - don't worry!). 

Till that is fixed you'll have to brute force your way to victory against the troll on his island!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/936c6c4976ddc409828d549a330042181cb4a924.png

Level 4 - Purple Head Monsters...
This island you will have to come up against... uhh... how do you describe this guys?!?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/078a94c0d4e1a6d757f32041e4af292e39f7480d.png

Yeah the purple head monsters will be roaming this island. Take control of the island to move on while avoiding these guys! Plus you get access to sand and snow biomes!

Level 5 - ???
If you can make it here, well done, I wish you luck with the finale! I won't spoil anything here (;

Final words
As always, gameplay has been improved, bugs have been removed and the game is evergrowing with purpose and fun gaming!

Some more major changes:

Movement has been overhauled, it's so much cleaner now haha!
Trolls can now jump... Run away!
Orcs now have a leader, and once that leader dies they will try to flee!


We have currently removed crafting as play testing has revealed it was too difficult to play with. But don't worry we are currently working on a crafting overhaul update so stay tuned!

Thanks for the support as always!
Luke

notes.title: World Procedural Generation Update!
notes.notes:
G'day everyone!

Brand new World Procedural Generation Update has been released on our Demo. Go try it out!  

You are now on one giant island to go explore and adventure around. Obviously the limit to the world is the ocean border of the island. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/6dadd54b43340f609e7b79eb0c9fd019a5d790e5.png

Here's some pictures of the current biomes available to explore:

Forest Biome 

 Mainly trees lol
 Birds can only be found in Forest Biomes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/7cf6a6624bee7af4a3a2f45a0b1d6b91e71d7e7d.png

Snow Biome

 Has Orc Camps and Berry Bushes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/4358c8ac10e1cfdc4342a8483f1fdad860b2f3c9.png

Mountain Biome

 Trolls have been limited to Mountain Biomes
 Orc Camps can also spawn in Mountain Biomes
 Loot is only found in these biomes. While hostile, it is worth exploring to find some weapons for your Reclaimers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/d6306431634b47bde7b07037e5af23576af0ac17.png

Plains Biome

 VIllages spawn here. Come here to recruit new members to your Reclaimer army!
 Bushes and some trees spawn in this Biome

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/b23c001f82a2e40d2ca93fc907e6e4dc876320fe.png

Some FYI's:

 We currently intend to release this game in early 2025. 
 We plan to begin to start releasing new regular updates every few weeks so keep an eye out for new and exciting features
 It takes like a minute to load the game. This is due to inefficent world spawning. We intend to make loading time a thing of the past!
 Please give feedback! We are looking out for any ideas to include in the game (:


We are going to add alot more stuff to the game, including base building, actual game progression, bosses, proper orc outposts and more!

Hope you're as excited as I am, see you all next time!
Luke
